title: Novel in situ SEI fabrication on Zn anodes for ultra-high current density tolerance enabled by electrical excitation–conjugation of iminoacetonitriles
content:
Energy Environ. Sci., 2025, 18,1011-1026
DOI: 10.1039/D4EE03624G, Paper
Ruqian Zhang, Tao Shui, An Li, Huan Xia, Gang Xu, Lingfeng Ji, Chengjie Lu, Wei Zhang, ZhengMing Sun
Electroplating enriched IDAN on zinc surface, forming IDA to complex with Zn2+, thus creating an in situ SEI. This SEI optimized Zn2+ transport, shielded water molecules, and stabilized the anode interface, enhancing long-term performance.
